Diego just smiled and nodded.
"Of course!
But you can say that they have a different way of helping your Genes improve.
Ahem...
This is our Nova Gene Enhancement Serum...
I can guarantee you that if you had at least 5 of these within your body, you’d get an explosive Gene Skill for sure!
If you did not get a Gene Skill, we will be paying you back!"
Diege said confidence.
"What?"
"Guaranteed?"
"Now now...
I have dibs on that then."
"Don’t worry...
We have plenty of them, you will be able to have yours."
"Wait...
I thought they were rare?
Can you actually produce these Serums?"
"Ahh...
No.
It’s not like that.
We just found quite a lot of them in the process.
We don’t make these things."
Well, no one could really confirm this matter.
Still, the fact that they have a money-back guarantee made him sound a bit more trustworthy.
He then changed the topic as he lifted one of the crates, opening it to reveal a cube the size of a fist.
It pulsed faintly, dormant but alive.
"These cubes..." he said, "are Gene Weapons.
But not the usual kind.
These are defensive Gene Weapons, identified and appraised by experts.
As you can see, they were all in their dormant cube form, waiting to be awakened.
Once bound to their owner, they manifest as shields, armor, or protective gear.
Do not expect swords, spears, or guns.
These are defensive items..."
The crowd murmured again in disbelief.
Defensive Gene Weapons were rare, and while they lacked offensive power, their value was undeniable.
In a world where survival often hinged on endurance, armor and shields could mean the difference between life and death.
Santiago raised his hands dramatically.
"We have twenty of these cubes!
Twenty!
Enough to change the fate of a guild, a faction, or a shelter.
Imagine your defenders clad in Gene Armor, your scouts protected by Gene Shields.
Facing the Sentinels would no longer be impossible!
Vera’s eyes widened.
She had her own Gene Weapon after the previous Global Events... but never defensive ones.
She turned to her companions, whispering, "This... this could make Blue Grass Shelter untouchable.
We have to get them all.
Atom wouldn’t be here forever."
Steven and Juno nodded as they also wanted such an item.
Diego and Santiago exchanged satisfied glances.
They knew the impact of their words.
Survivors were desperate for any edge, and defensive Gene Weapons were a rare edge indeed.
"Of course," Diego added, his tone practical, "such items are not cheap.
Survivor Medals will be required.
But think of what you gain.
Protection...
Security... and the ability to withstand assaults that would crush lesser shelters."
The guards were clearly impressed and knew that they had to get one.
Seeing their reaction, the merchants’ confidence was unshakable.
Santiago leaned closer to Vera as he believed that she was the leader of this shelter...
"You must have a lot of Survivor Medals...
Do you want me to give you suggestions?
You should have enough to claim one or two of these treasures...
If you want, I can test your affinity and give you better options."
Vera’s heart raced.
The Auction Event was already a golden opportunity to use her Survivor Medals... but this... this was immediate power.
She glanced at the wagons again, at the weapons, the food, and finally the Gene Weapons.
"Wait...
How long will you be staying here, Sir Merchants?"
Diego’s eyes shifted as if he was recalling their schedule before he answered.
"We’ll only stay here for six hours, Miss..." As he said this, his eyes soon noticed a familiar Sentinel Unit dressed like a normal person.
"Huh?
Isn’t that Atom?"

chapters.title: Chapter 285: The Ore Once Again
paragraphs: Diego’s eyes narrowed as he spotted Atom among the crowd. He exchanged a quick glance with Santiago before asking,
"Wait... is Sir Kai here?"
As soon as they heard this question, the residents perked up.
Vera straightened as she realized that their Guild Leader was truly famous. Her pride was evident in her tone... "Yes. This is now part of his territory."
The merchants’ expressions shifted... They may not have known the full details, but Kai’s reputation preceded him.
A Survivor who was capable of controlling an A-Grade Sentinel wasn’t something they could ignore.

Meanwhile, Vera and the others just knew that it wouldn’t be surprising for Kai to be that famous at all. Well, he was the Rank 1 Survivor on the Leaderboard for two consecutive months, and if the trend continued, the third month would be his as well.
Steven stepped forward... "Is there a problem?"
Diego quickly waved his hand. "No, no. Nothing like that. In fact, we’ve visited one of his shelters before. We remember him well. He left quite an impression, and we were hoping to meet him again."
Vera shook her head firmly. "He can’t be disturbed right now." She didn’t explain that Kai had entered the VR World for security reasons.
Instead, she asked, "What did you want to ask him?"
Santiago and Diego shared a smile. "It’s related to an item he might like... something that could help Atom."
That was all they said.
They didn’t press further, respecting Vera’s words.
Vera also didn’t ask further as she realized that the merchants just wanted to sell something to Kai.

After this matter was settled, they soon returned to the items being sold... They had just obtained new Survivor Medals, so they might as well purchase some items that might look good on them when the Auction date comes.
Well, they might meet other Survivors there, so perhaps, wearing high-quality clothes, luxurious accessories, a fancy hat, or even an expensive perfume would help them.
However, Vera considered their offer carefully...
Although immediate strength was not that important for the upcoming Auction Event, which should be peaceful, having a better Gene Weapon would always be helpful.
Finally, she decided. "I’ll take one of your defensive Gene Weapon."
The merchants nodded, and the transaction was swift.
Vera handed over 25 Survivor Medals. It was more expensive than the low‐grade Gene Weapons from Gene Traders, which cost 10 medals, but slightly cheaper than mid‐grade ones sold for 30.
The price seemed fair for what she received... a guaranteed shield‐type Gene Weapon cube.
Clutching the cube, Vera excused herself. She returned to her room, closing the door behind her.
Alone, she sat on her bed, staring at the dormant cube in her hands.
Her heart raced as she prepared to awaken it...
[ Dormant Gene Weapon Detected ]
[ Do you wish to awaken it and become its owner? ]
"Yes," she said firmly.
The cube vibrated instantly, as if it were humming with power.
Soon, its panels shifted, unfolding silently...
Then, she got the notifications.
[ Activating Gene Weapon. ]
[ Connection in progress. ]
[ Synchronizing Spirit Resonance. ]
[ Awakening Sequence Initiated. ]
Segments elongated, locking into place. Soon, it began compressing inward, forming a broad surface.
Clank... Clank...
Metallic plates expanded outward, and they were overlapping like scales. The core stretched into a curved barrier, and soon, Vera couldn’t help but laugh.
As an Alchemist, she relied heavily on weapons if she needed to attack instead of using Gene Skills. Now, she could also rely on her gene weapon if needed to protect herself and her surroundings.
Just like that, the weapon stabilized.
It was a shield, polished and durable...
[ Gene Weapon Awakened: Praetorian Shield ]
[ Grade: Mid ]
[ Type: Round Shield ]
[ Effect: Reduces incoming damage by 50%. Generates a protective barrier when Spirit Energy is channeled. Effective against ranged attacks and energy-based attacks. ]
Vera exhaled, satisfied with this shield.

She now had three Gene Weapons... one earned from the Global Events, one purchased from the Gene Traders for 10 Survivor Medals, and now this shield... the most expensive, bought for 25 Survivor Medals. It was worth every point.
Not long after, Steven and Juno returned to their own rooms with the cubes they had purchased. The same awakening sequence unfolded for them...
They soon obtained their special Gene Weapons.
Steven’s cube became a heavy chestplate, while Juno’s transformed into a bracer that projected a defensive field.
[ Gene Weapon Awakened: Ironwall Chestplate ]
[ Grade: Mid ]
[ Type: Defensive Armor ]
[ Effect: Reduces incoming damage by 45%. Reinforces whole body protection with Aura. Generates a stabilizing wave of energy that lessens knockback and impact damage. ]
[ Gene Weapon Awakened: Guardian Bracer ]
[ Grade: Mid ]
[ Type: Defensive Bracer ]
[ Effect: Reduces incoming damage by 55%. Projects a defensive energy field when Spirit Energy is channeled. Effective for shielding allies in close proximity. ]
Just like that, the three of them gathered later, as they were all feeling excited with their new items.
After all, they felt truly secure with these Gene Weapons ready to be activated. anytime they wanted.
The next morning, the shelter was unusually quiet.
Vera and the others gathered for breakfast, but their minds were elsewhere.
Kai had not left his room since the previous day, and though they trusted him, the silence weighed heavily.
After finishing their meal, they decided to check on him.
Together, they walked to the Guild Leader’s house.
There, they found Atom was still stationed outside, standing like an immovable guard. His glowing eyes scanned them, but he did not allow anyone to approach.
Steven frowned. "Still guarding. He hasn’t come out at all."
Vera bit her lip, but then remembered the Guild System. She quickly opened her blue screen interface, and the others followed suit. Relief washed over them as Kai’s name appeared in green.
[ Guild Leader: Kai ]
If he had died, his name would have vanished from the list. The system confirmed he was alive, even if he remained inside.
Satisfied, they turned to leave, planning to visit the merchant caravan that had stayed overnight. Just then, the door creaked open.
Kai stepped out, smiling faintly, his posture relaxed, and he seemed to be filled with energy.
"Kai!" Vera exclaimed, rushing forward. "What happened? You look like you enjoyed it."
Kai chuckled, his voice calm but brimming with excitement.
"Yes... it’s amazing. I’ll explain later. For now, what’s with these people outside? I sensed some visitors..."
He was quite sensitive after finishing his game, so he noticed the guests immediately.

Steven nodded and he gestured toward the wagons parked nearby. "Merchants. They arrived yesterday with guards and strange devices... They have signal jammers, we think. Anyway, they’re selling weapons, supplies, and Gene Enhancements. They wanted to speak with you specifically, about something that could benefit Atom."
Kai’s expression sharpened with interest. He nodded slowly. "Diego and Santiago... I remember them."
Vera confirmed, "Yes, those are their names. They said they had something special, but wouldn’t explain further until they met you."
Kai adjusted his coat and walked toward the caravan.
"Alright... Let me see what they wanted to offer."
The merchants spotted him immediately, their faces lighting up.
Diego stepped forward, bowing slightly. "Sir Kai. Congratulations on expanding your territory. It seems shelters are thriving under your leadership."
Kai inclined his head. "Thank you. But tell me...why did you want to meet me? What is this item you claim could help Atom?"
Santiago grinned.
"We have something rare. Something not even the Gene Traders can offer. Special metals, salvaged from a vault untouched by the A.I. Army. We believe they can enhance Atom’s systems."
Kai’s eyes narrowed. "Special metals? What kind?"
Diego lifted a small crate and opened it carefully. Inside was a dull, silvery mineral that shimmered faintly with a bluish glow.
"This," Diego said, "is Aetherium Ore."
Kai’s breath caught. He had heard of it before...
To be exact, Victor and others from New Haven-45 had also collected these from the A.I. Army!
But even with Victor’s Appraisal, they could only find basic information about it.
The two then continued to explain...
Here, Kai confirmed how Aetherium was said to be a mineral modified by Anima itself, a fusion of natural iron ore and alien energy.
Its properties were extraordinary as it could reinforce plasma weapons, stabilize energy barriers, and repair advanced constructs.

Santiago continued, "We discovered a hidden cache while traveling through the ruins of an old military research facility. The A.I. Army hasn’t touched it yet. We managed to extract enough to fill several crates. And now, we’re offering it to you for a lower price..."

Kai studied the ore, his mind racing. Atom was already formidable, but with Aetherium integrated into his systems, his durability and combat potential could increase dramatically. Shields reinforced, circuits stabilized, armor enhanced... it was exactly what Atom needed to withstand the escalating threats.
Kai finally spoke.
"You’ve done well to bring this here. How much do you have, and what’s the price?"

Diego smiled knowingly. "It’s not easy... As for the price... we’ll discuss that. But understand, Sir Kai, this is a great opportunity. With Aetherium, Atom could become the strongest Sentinel in this land. So... instead of survivor medals or energy cores, how about a trade?"
Kai was curious... "A trade? Then let’s talk. Tell me about it..."

chapters.title: Chapter 286: The Upgrade!
paragraphs: Kai stood before the merchants and glanced at the mysterious ore they presented.
The bluish glow reflected faintly against his coat, and he could already imagine Atom’s systems reinforced by such a resource.

Diego cleared his throat. "Sir Kai, we know what you’re thinking. This ore is rare, and it’s powerful. We’re not asking for Survivor Medals or Energy Cores. Instead, we want something practical. Something we’ve seen with our own eyes."
"A trade? Then let’s talk. Tell me more about it..." Kai replied.
Santiago clasped his hands and replied. "The Atmospheric Water Generator. The one your shelter uses."
The crowd around them stirred. Vera’s eyes widened.
Steven muttered... "No wonder they kept looking at it. They’re really interested..."
Kai’s smile was calm and nodded. He knew how valuable it was, and it wouldn’t be surprising that they wanted it.

As a matter of fact, Cornelio Aries was still to trade one of these for a single Skill Fusion Crystal. Thanks to that, Kai had something he’d be able to sell to the residents of his shelter, giving him a better chance of earning Survivor Medals from them.
"It’s not easy to obtain them." Kai lied as he acted as if he was troubled.
Of course, it was true that the Atmospheric Water Generator was one of his most valuable devices.

It was portable, compact, and capable of extracting moisture directly from the air. It was such a unique device that produced clean, drinkable water even in arid environments. With one of these, a shelter would never worry about thirst again as long as they had Spirit Energy to activate it.

Diego continued, "We saw it in action yesterday. Survivors here drink freely, without rationing. That’s not normal in this wasteland. If we had one of those devices, our caravan could sustain itself indefinitely. And any shelter we trade with would pay dearly for it."
Santiago raised a finger. "For ten pieces of Aetherium Ore, we’ll accept one Atmospheric Water Generator."
Kai repeated... "Ten ores for one generator?"

Diego nodded firmly. "Water is life. And in this world, life is worth more than medals. I hope you can be generous. In exchange, our caravan will pass through this shelter in a routine, giving you access to more food, fabrics, and other items you can’t find anywhere."
"I see... That’s tempting..."
Kai thought carefully.
He could produce these devices infinitely through his Gift Pack talent, but revealing that fact was dangerous.
He couldn’t afford to flood the market with them, or suspicion would rise. He needed to limit his trades, keep the illusion of scarcity intact, and make them more valuable or precious.
Finally, he spoke. "How much ore do you have?"
Santiago’s grin widened. "Three hundred pieces. Enough to help create about a hundred Aetherium Swords.

Kai’s eyes gleamed. Three hundred pieces of Aetherium Ore were a staggering amount. It wouldn’t just be for Atom then... He could rebuild or upgrade other Modified Sentinels beyond imagination. But he couldn’t hand over thirty generators... not yet.
"I only have ten more of those devices available," Kai said firmly. "As of now, I’ll accept one hundred and fifty pieces of ore in exchange for them."
Diego frowned slightly. "Ten generators for one hundred and fifty ores... that’s half our stock."
Kai raised his hand. "I’m not finished. I have other items you may find useful. Items you won’t find anywhere else."
He gestured, and Vera led them to the warehouse. Inside, crates stacked high revealed his surplus. Kai opened one, showing rows of advanced equipment.
"Thermal detection goggles. Portable disruptor field units... and Advanced camouflage gear."
The merchants leaned closer, their eyes widening.

"These," Kai explained, "are part of my surplus. Camouflage gear, thermal detection goggles, disruptor units... all tested and reliable. I’ve been selling them to other Survivors or Merchants, but I can trade them with you guys."
Diego picked up a pair of goggles, inspecting them. "Thermal detection... this could spot hidden mutants or cloaked drones."
Santiago tested the disruptor unit, watching its faint pulse. "Portable field disruption. This could jam sensors, confuse Sentinels, or even block communication chanels... Impressive."
Kai smiled faintly. "I can provide sets of these. If you’re interested, we can add them to the deal.
Diego and Santiago exchanged glances. They were merchants, and they knew opportunity when they saw it.
Kai continued, "For every set of three...one camouflage gear, one thermal goggle, one disruptor unit... I’ll accept five pieces of Aetherium Ore."
Santiago’s eyes lit up. "Five ores for a set? That’s fair. I think other Survivors would pay much more for this kind of technology."
Kai nodded. "I can provide twenty sets. That’s another one hundred ores."
Diego calculated quickly. "So... ten generators for one hundred and fifty ores, plus twenty sets of stealth equipment for one hundred ores. That’s two hundred and fifty ores total."
Kai’s smile widened. "Exactly. You can trade the other 50 ores to others... Two hundred and fifty ores will be more than enough for my Blacksmiths for now..."
Kai didn’t have a lot of blacksmiths anyway. Having 250 pieces was already more than enough.
The merchants whispered to each other, weighing the deal. Finally, Santiago extended his hand. "Agreed. Two hundred and fifty ores for your devices and equipment."
Kai clasped his hand firmly. "Then it’s settled."
The crown around them murmured in awe.
Vera wasn’t sure how great these Aetherium Ores were, but since Kai was willing to purchase most of them, they must be really good.
Steven and Juno were also curious, but in the end, they were happy to see Kai smiling in satisfaction.
Soon, Kai carried the crates of Aetherium Ore into his small house, with Atom following silently behind him.
The others had already dispersed, leaving him alone with the Sentinel.
Thud...
As soon as the last crate was placed, without waiting for a command, Atom moved.
The machine’s eyes flared brighter, and it immediately sat beside the crates containing the ores. Its armored hands reached forward, touching the minerals.
Soon, a low hum filled the air. The ores began to vibrate, their glow intensifying.
Then, one by one, they dissolved into streams of energy that flowed directly into Atom’s chassis. Dust and unusable fragments scattered onto the floor, crumbling into nothingness.
Crack... Crack...
Kai watched silently.
He had seen this before... when Atom absorbed black metals from Tyrants and other powerful units of the A.I. Army. Back then, his low-level Appraisal Skill couldn’t identify the black metal at all.
But now, with the merchants’ explanation and Victor’s confirmation from New Haven-45, he understood. Those black metals had been Aetherium all along.
It made sense.
The A.I. Army had been transporting and weaponizing this ore. Victor’s appraisal had revealed fragments of its properties, but seeing Atom absorb it directly confirmed the truth.
Soon, after Atom had consumed about fifty pieces, something changed. Its body pulsed with radiant energy...
For some reason, its started circuits glowing brighter than ever before.
"This..."
The floor trembled slightly, and Kai’s blue screen interface appeared in front of him!
[ Sentinel Upgrade Detected ]
[ Processing absorbed Aetherium... ]
[ Compatibility: 100% ]
[ Reinforcement Threshold Reached ]
[ A-Grade Sentinel: Atom ]
[ Status: Evolution in Progress ]
[ Consumed Resource: 50 Aetherium Ore ]
[ Triggering Grade Advancement... ]
Kai’s breath caught as the final notification unfolded across his screen...
"This..."
[ Sentinel Evolution Complete ]
[ Sentinel Atom has advanced from A-Grade to S-Grade ]
[ New Classification: S-Grade Sentinel - Atom ]
[ Core Systems Reinforced ]
[ Durability: +300% ]
[ Energy Circuits Stabilized ]
[ Barrier Generation Efficiency: +250% ]
[ Operating Duration Extended - Continuous activity sustained far longer than previous grade ]
[ Additional Functions Unlocked ]
- Adaptive Energy Shield: Generates a dynamic barrier that adjusts to incoming attack types.
- Self-Repair Protocol: Atom can regenerate structural damage over time using absorbed energy.
- Overdrive Mode: Temporarily increases combat output by 200% when Spirit Energy is channeled. ]
[ Current Synchronization: Perfect ]
[ Owner: Kai ]
Kai’s eyes widened.
He had expected Atom to grow stronger, but this... this was beyond anything he had imagined. An S-Grade Sentinel wasn’t something he was expecting at all!
Atom rose slowly...
At this point, its clothes had already turned to dust due to the power it had.
Furthermore, the previous metallic sheen changed. It was as if Atom was painted black!
Indeed! From its previous silver color, it was now completely black!
"S-Grade... Atom." Kai whispered, almost reverently.
The Sentinel turned its gaze toward him, and for a moment, Kai felt the weight of its presence. It felt as if this was no longer just a machine.

Memories of past battles flashed through his mind... how Atom had stood against Tyrants, how it had shielded them from other Survivors and even Mutants... how it had endured blows that would have crushed lesser machines.
Now, with this upgrade, Atom’s potential was limitless.
"Perfect! Let’s see what you can do! Let’s spar!" Kai was excited!
Of course, he wouldn’t let Atom fight against him unarmed.
Soon, he made Atom choose an equipment to wear and a weapon to equip... Whether it was a sword, an axe, a spear, or even a whip, Kai didn’t care...
He wanted to see whether Atom would surprise him even more.
But as he laid out the weapons in front of Atom, something unexpected happened.
Shiing~
A blade came out of its arm!

sentences.text: Kai stood before the merchants and glanced at the mysterious ore they presented.
The bluish glow reflected faintly against his coat, and he could already imagine Atom’s systems reinforced by such a resource.
Diego cleared his throat.
"Sir Kai, we know what you’re thinking.
This ore is rare, and it’s powerful.
We’re not asking for Survivor Medals or Energy Cores.
Instead, we want something practical.
Something we’ve seen with our own eyes."
"A trade?
Then let’s talk.
Tell me more about it..." Kai replied.
Santiago clasped his hands and replied.
"The Atmospheric Water Generator.
The one your shelter uses."
The crowd around them stirred.
Vera’s eyes widened.
Steven muttered...
"No wonder they kept looking at it.
They’re really interested..."
Kai’s smile was calm and nodded.
He knew how valuable it was, and it wouldn’t be surprising that they wanted it.
As a matter of fact, Cornelio Aries was still to trade one of these for a single Skill Fusion Crystal.
Thanks to that, Kai had something he’d be able to sell to the residents of his shelter, giving him a better chance of earning Survivor Medals from them.
"It’s not easy to obtain them." Kai lied as he acted as if he was troubled.
Of course, it was true that the Atmospheric Water Generator was one of his most valuable devices.
It was portable, compact, and capable of extracting moisture directly from the air.
It was such a unique device that produced clean, drinkable water even in arid environments.
With one of these, a shelter would never worry about thirst again as long as they had Spirit Energy to activate it.
Diego continued, "We saw it in action yesterday.
Survivors here drink freely, without rationing.
That’s not normal in this wasteland.
If we had one of those devices, our caravan could sustain itself indefinitely.
And any shelter we trade with would pay dearly for it."
Santiago raised a finger.
"For ten pieces of Aetherium Ore, we’ll accept one Atmospheric Water Generator."
Kai repeated...
"Ten ores for one generator?"
Diego nodded firmly.
"Water is life.
And in this world, life is worth more than medals.
I hope you can be generous.
In exchange, our caravan will pass through this shelter in a routine, giving you access to more food, fabrics, and other items you can’t find anywhere."
"I see...
That’s tempting..."
Kai thought carefully.
He could produce these devices infinitely through his Gift Pack talent, but revealing that fact was dangerous.
He couldn’t afford to flood the market with them, or suspicion would rise.
He needed to limit his trades, keep the illusion of scarcity intact, and make them more valuable or precious.
Finally, he spoke.
"How much ore do you have?"
Santiago’s grin widened.
"Three hundred pieces.
Enough to help create about a hundred Aetherium Swords.
Kai’s eyes gleamed.
Three hundred pieces of Aetherium Ore were a staggering amount.
It wouldn’t just be for Atom then...
He could rebuild or upgrade other Modified Sentinels beyond imagination.
But he couldn’t hand over thirty generators... not yet.
"I only have ten more of those devices available," Kai said firmly.
"As of now, I’ll accept one hundred and fifty pieces of ore in exchange for them."
Diego frowned slightly.
"Ten generators for one hundred and fifty ores... that’s half our stock."
Kai raised his hand.
"I’m not finished.
I have other items you may find useful.
Items you won’t find anywhere else."
He gestured, and Vera led them to the warehouse.
Inside, crates stacked high revealed his surplus.
Kai opened one, showing rows of advanced equipment.
"Thermal detection goggles.
Portable disruptor field units... and Advanced camouflage gear."
The merchants leaned closer, their eyes widening.
"These," Kai explained, "are part of my surplus.
Camouflage gear, thermal detection goggles, disruptor units... all tested and reliable.
I’ve been selling them to other Survivors or Merchants, but I can trade them with you guys."
Diego picked up a pair of goggles, inspecting them.
"Thermal detection... this could spot hidden mutants or cloaked drones."
Santiago tested the disruptor unit, watching its faint pulse.
"Portable field disruption.
This could jam sensors, confuse Sentinels, or even block communication chanels...
Impressive."
Kai smiled faintly.
"I can provide sets of these.
If you’re interested, we can add them to the deal.
Diego and Santiago exchanged glances.
They were merchants, and they knew opportunity when they saw it.
Kai continued, "For every set of three...one camouflage gear, one thermal goggle, one disruptor unit...
I’ll accept five pieces of Aetherium Ore."
Santiago’s eyes lit up.
"Five ores for a set?
That’s fair.
I think other Survivors would pay much more for this kind of technology."
Kai nodded.
"I can provide twenty sets.
That’s another one hundred ores."
Diego calculated quickly.
"So... ten generators for one hundred and fifty ores, plus twenty sets of stealth equipment for one hundred ores.
That’s two hundred and fifty ores total."
Kai’s smile widened.
"Exactly.
You can trade the other 50 ores to others...
Two hundred and fifty ores will be more than enough for my Blacksmiths for now..."
Kai didn’t have a lot of blacksmiths anyway.
Having 250 pieces was already more than enough.
The merchants whispered to each other, weighing the deal.
Finally, Santiago extended his hand.
"Agreed.
Two hundred and fifty ores for your devices and equipment."
Kai clasped his hand firmly.
"Then it’s settled."
The crown around them murmured in awe.
Vera wasn’t sure how great these Aetherium Ores were, but since Kai was willing to purchase most of them, they must be really good.
Steven and Juno were also curious, but in the end, they were happy to see Kai smiling in satisfaction.
Soon, Kai carried the crates of Aetherium Ore into his small house, with Atom following silently behind him.
The others had already dispersed, leaving him alone with the Sentinel.
Thud...
As soon as the last crate was placed, without waiting for a command, Atom moved.
The machine’s eyes flared brighter, and it immediately sat beside the crates containing the ores.
Its armored hands reached forward, touching the minerals.
Soon, a low hum filled the air.
The ores began to vibrate, their glow intensifying.
Then, one by one, they dissolved into streams of energy that flowed directly into Atom’s chassis.
Dust and unusable fragments scattered onto the floor, crumbling into nothingness.
Crack...
Crack...
Kai watched silently.
He had seen this before... when Atom absorbed black metals from Tyrants and other powerful units of the A.I.
Army.
Back then, his low-level Appraisal Skill couldn’t identify the black metal at all.
But now, with the merchants’ explanation and Victor’s confirmation from New Haven-45, he understood.
Those black metals had been Aetherium all along.
It made sense.
The A.I.
Army had been transporting and weaponizing this ore.
Victor’s appraisal had revealed fragments of its properties, but seeing Atom absorb it directly confirmed the truth.
Soon, after Atom had consumed about fifty pieces, something changed.
Its body pulsed with radiant energy...
For some reason, its started circuits glowing brighter than ever before.
"This..."
The floor trembled slightly, and Kai’s blue screen interface appeared in front of him!
[ Sentinel Upgrade Detected ]
[ Processing absorbed Aetherium... ]
[ Compatibility: 100% ]
[ Reinforcement Threshold Reached ]
[ A-Grade Sentinel: Atom ]
[ Status: Evolution in Progress ]
[ Consumed Resource: 50 Aetherium Ore ]
[ Triggering Grade Advancement... ]
Kai’s breath caught as the final notification unfolded across his screen...
"This..."
[ Sentinel Evolution Complete ]
[ Sentinel Atom has advanced from A-Grade to S-Grade ]
[ New Classification: S-Grade Sentinel - Atom ]
[ Core Systems Reinforced ]
[ Durability: +300% ]
[ Energy Circuits Stabilized ]
[ Barrier Generation Efficiency: +250% ]
[ Operating Duration Extended - Continuous activity sustained far longer than previous grade ]
[ Additional Functions Unlocked ]
- Adaptive Energy Shield: Generates a dynamic barrier that adjusts to incoming attack types.
- Self-Repair Protocol: Atom can regenerate structural damage over time using absorbed energy.
- Overdrive Mode: Temporarily increases combat output by 200% when Spirit Energy is channeled. ]
[ Current Synchronization: Perfect ]
[ Owner: Kai ]
Kai’s eyes widened.
He had expected Atom to grow stronger, but this... this was beyond anything he had imagined.
An S-Grade Sentinel wasn’t something he was expecting at all!
Atom rose slowly...
At this point, its clothes had already turned to dust due to the power it had.
Furthermore, the previous metallic sheen changed.
It was as if Atom was painted black!
Indeed!
From its previous silver color, it was now completely black!
"S-Grade...
Atom." Kai whispered, almost reverently.
The Sentinel turned its gaze toward him, and for a moment, Kai felt the weight of its presence.
It felt as if this was no longer just a machine.

Memories of past battles flashed through his mind... how Atom had stood against Tyrants, how it had shielded them from other Survivors and even Mutants... how it had endured blows that would have crushed lesser machines.
Now, with this upgrade, Atom’s potential was limitless.
"Perfect!
Let’s see what you can do!
Let’s spar!" Kai was excited!
Of course, he wouldn’t let Atom fight against him unarmed.
Soon, he made Atom choose an equipment to wear and a weapon to equip...
Whether it was a sword, an axe, a spear, or even a whip, Kai didn’t care...
He wanted to see whether Atom would surprise him even more.
But as he laid out the weapons in front of Atom, something unexpected happened.
Shiing~
A blade came out of its arm!

chapters.title: Chapter 287: The Fusions
paragraphs: "Whoaaa... You have a built-in weapon now? That’s cool." Kai muttered as he knew that the previous A-Grade Sentinel didn’t have anything close to that.
Atom didn’t answer but it seemed that it was looking really proud of itself.
Kai had a feeling that this Sentinel had gotten more intelligent!
"Mhmm... I guess I have to take this seriously." Kai muttered as he recalled how he obtained several Skill Fusion Crystals from the Aries Faction.
For now, he decided to check his current stat. After all, he had obtained various Skills within the Perfect World and also from the Gene Skill Crystals he had used recently.
Unfortunately, the limit of Level 35 Survivor was still seven for each Active and Passive Skill.
"Alright... Where should I start?" Kai muttered as he checked his status...
[ Name: Kai ]
[ Title: Expert Survivor, Trailblazer, Stronghold Defender, Guardian, Strongest One ]
[ Guild: Codebreakers ]
[ Level: 35 ]
[ Physique Rating: C+ ]
[ Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS) ]
[ Active Skills: Spirit Pulse Lv5, Specter Step Lv5, Fast Appraisal Lv5, Beast Arm Lv5, Armored Dash Lv0, Spirit Chains Lv0, Piercing Roar Lv0 ]
[ Passive Skills: Keen Sense Lv5, Bio Adaptive Constitution Lv5, Battle Trance Lv5, Bronze Skin Lv5, Iron Will Lv0, Spirit Conduction Lv0, Hunter Sense Lv0 ]
[ Skill Points: 6 ]
[ Reputation Points: 64 ]
[ Inventory Slots: 9 ]
Kai stared at the blue screen. His list of skills had grown, but he knew better than to spread himself thin.
Seven active, seven passive... There were too many to manage with limited skill points...
He reached into his inventory and withdrew three crystalline shards for now...
[ Item: Skill Fusion Crystal ]
[ Effect: Allows fusion of two or more Gene Skills into a new hybrid skill. Higher compatibility produces stronger results. Single-use, bound to the Survivor. ]
The crystals pulsed faintly, waiting to be used. Kai clenched his fist.
"Mhmm... I guess Appraisal and Bio‐Adaptive Constitution stay. The rest... I’ll fuse them. Better to focus on fewer, stronger skills."

Kai needed the Appraisal for obvious reasons, while the Bio-Adaptive was also very important as it was the skill allowing him to not be afraid of any modifications, and also, it helped him consume more Gene Enhancements without suffering backlash.
He then activated one of the Fusion Crystals...
[ Skill Fusion Crystal Activated ]
[ Eligible Gene Skills Detected ]
[ Active Skills: Spirit Pulse Lv5, Specter Step Lv5... ]
[ Passive Skills: Keen Sense Lv5, Bio‐Adaptive Constitution Lv5...]
[ Instruction: Select up to 5 Gene Skills to fuse together. ]
[ Note: Minimum requirement is 2 Gene Skills. Fusion will proceed with chosen skills. ]
[ Warning: The more skills selected, the higher the risk of failure or unstable results unless compatibility is high. ]
[ Note: Choose carefully. Fusion outcomes are permanent. ]
Kai exhaled slowly. "Alright... let’s begin. Oh... Atom, just stay there. We’ll spar after this."
Just like that, Kai highlighted Spirit Pulse, Piercing Roar, and Spirit Chains.
[ Selected Skills: Spirit Pulse Lv5 + Piercing Roar Lv0 + Spirit Chains Lv0 ]
[ Compatibility: High ]
[ Fusion in Progress... ]
The crystal glowed, merging the three abilities into one.
[ Fusion Successful ]
[ New Active Skill Acquired: Spirit Dominion Lv2 ]
[ Note: Combines ranged burst, immobilization, and disruption into a single Spirit‐based attack. ]
Kai nodded as he saw it... "Perfect. One skill that covers offense, control, and suppression."
After that, Kai used the second crystal...
This time, he selected Specter Step, Armored Dash, and Beast Arm.
[ Selected Skills: Specter Step Lv5 + Armored Dash Lv0 + Beast Arm Lv5 ]
[ Compatibility: Moderate ]
[ Fusion in Progress... ]
"Moderate, huh... Interesting."
The crystal then pulsed violently before stabilizing.
[ Fusion Successful ]
[ New Active Skill Acquired: Titan Step Lv0 ]
[ Effect: A mobility skill that fuses phasing movement, armored charge, and brute transformation. ]
Kai grinned. "Mobility and raw strength in one. That’s exactly what I need."

He then turned his attention to his passive skills. He knew he couldn’t keep them all as they were... too scattered, too inefficient. He placed another crystal in his hands and soon, it started glowing and pulsing steadily.
[ Skill Fusion Crystal Activated ]
[ Eligible Gene Skills Detected ]...
Kai selected Bronze Skin and Battle Trance.
[ Selected Skills: Bronze Skin Lv5 + Battle Trance Lv5 ]
[ Compatibility: High ]
[ Fusion in Progress... ]
The crystal flared brilliantly, merging the two passives into a single advanced trait.
[ Fusion Successful ]
[ New Passive Skill Acquired: Great Protection Lv0 ]
[ Effect: Combines hardened defense with heightened combat resilience. ]
Kai clenched his fists, feeling his body stabilize... his muscles even started tightening with newfound endurance. "This... this is incredible. Just perfect for what I needed."
He wasn’t finished. He placed another crystal down, this time focusing on Spirit Conduction and Hunter Sense.
[ Skill Fusion Crystal Activated ]
Kai selected Spirit Conduction and Hunter Sense.
[ Selected Skills: Spirit Conduction Lv0 + Hunter Sense Lv0 ]
[ Compatibility: Moderate ]
[ Fusion in Progress... ]
The crystal pulsed violently before stabilizing, merging the two into a better passive.
[ Fusion Successful ]
[ New Passive Skill Acquired: Slayer’s Flow Lv0 ]
[ Effect: Enhances Spirit efficiency while sharpening instinctive awareness of hostile intent. ]
Kai exhaled, satisfied. "Perfect... They’re all fused into one."
[ Active Skills: Fast Appraisal Lv5, Spirit Dominion Lv2, Titan Step Lv0 ]
[ Passive Skills: Bio‐Adaptive Constitution Lv5, Great Protection Lv0, Slayer’s Flow Lv0 ]
Kai stared at the condensed list. From the fourteen skills, he now had a few of them.
He muttered, "This is better. No clutter. Just the essentials."
The crystals had done their work. His arsenal was definitely a lot better than before...
Spirit Dominion gave him control over the battlefield. Titan Step fused mobility and brute force... and Slayer fortified his body and instincts...
Kai exhaled and slowed his breath.
"Now... Atom. What do you think?"
Kai pushed open the door of his small house, stepping into the cool morning air.
Atom followed, its black armor looked so intimidating as well. Since the built-in blade retracted as it moved with silent precision.
Kai stretched his arms, rolling his shoulders, and began warming up.
His muscles tightened under the effect of Great Protection, every movement felt more comfortable and controlled.
He drew in a deep breath, letting Slayer’s Flow circulate Spirit Energy through his body more efficiently than ever before.
"Atom... I’m ready!"

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Kai vs Atom
paragraphs: The heavy gates creaked open as Kai stepped outside the shelter with Atom following close behind.
The Sentinel’s black armor looked so new, and no one had actually realized that it was Atom at first.
"Trust me... That’s an Evolved Atom!" Kai could only say as the others couldn’t help but look wary.
"Awesome..."
"That looks beautiful."
"I want to have one as well. Wait... Are you going to hunt outside, Sir Kai?" One of the guards asked.
"We’re just going to spar. I don’t think it’s appropriate to use the training grounds." Kai replied.
Hearing that they were about to spar, many residents had gotten curious. Even the escorts of the Merchant Caravan couldn’t help but look interested.
They wanted to see some entertainment before leaving this shelter.
Just like that, from the ramparts above, several survivors leaned over the edge, curious.
Vera, Steven, and Juno were among them, their eyes were also filled with anticipation. Others gathered in the watchtower as they waited for the match to start.
It wasn’t every day they saw Kai spar with Atom, especially now that the Sentinel had ascended to a higher level.
Kai stretched his arms, rolling his shoulders, warming up his body.
His muscles felt really nice under the effect of Great Protection, every movement smooth and more controlled.
"Hu~"
He drew in a deep breath, letting Slayer’s Flow circulate Spirit Energy through his body more efficiently than ever before...
"Alright, Atom," Kai muttered, his voice steady. "Let’s give them a show. Don’t hold back too much."
Atom didn’t respond, but its eyes or optics glowed brighter.
Soon, the blade extended with a metallic hiss, gleaming like obsidian. Its stance shifted, precise and deliberate, as if acknowledging Kai’s words.
Kai smirked faintly. "Good. Let’s begin."
Kai had three Gene Weapons. They were Specter Edge, Strength Gauntlet, and War Lance.
He could immediately start with these Gene Weapons, but for now, he decided to rely on his physique.
Bam!
The spar started with a sudden burst. Kai launched forward, activating Titan Step. His body moved so quickly, phasing briefly as he dashed across the open ground.
Boom!
The impact of his landing sent a ripple through the dirt, a shockwave of force that made the ramparts tremble.
Atom raised its blade instantly, intercepting Kai’s charge and meeting his palm strike!
"Let’s see!"
Steel clashed against Spirit‐reinforced Flesh.
Bam!
The collision echoed like thunder.
Kai gritted his teeth, pushing forward with brute strength, his arm swelling under the residual effect of Beast Arm woven into Titan Step.
Indeed, despite the fusion, the essence of the Beast Arm was still there!
’So this is what it means by combining high compatibility skills...’
Atom held firm. Its body was able to absorb the impact from his strike... Still, the blade scraped against Kai’s hardened skin.
"Not bad," Kai muttered before stepping back. After adjusting his balance, he then raised his hand.
And used up a chunk of his Spirit Points...
[ Skill Activated: Spirit Dominion ]
Chains made of Spirit Energy burst forth, lashing out toward Atom.
They wrapped around its limbs, with its suppressive force. At the same time, a shockwave erupted, disrupting the air and scattering dust.
Boom!
Even the ramparts shook as the energy pulse reverberated outward!
Atom staggered for a moment, but its systems quickly realized the strength of his Gene Skill and swiftly adjusted its power!
Still, the chains tightened, immobilizing its arms. Kai smirked. "Got you."
But Atom finally gathered its momentum!
Its Adaptive Energy Shield was activated, covering its entire body. The chains strained, then shattered against the barrier.
Atom stepped forward with its blade slicing through the air!
Thankfully, his movement skill refreshed its cooldown, so he activated Titan Step again. His body vanished, phasing past the strike, before reappearing behind Atom.
"Haa!"
He swung his fist, reinforced by the titan force behind the movement skill!
Kai wasn’t sure where the best place to hit but in the end, he struck Atom’s back!
Bam!
The blow landed with a resounding crack, forcing Atom forward a step.
The crowd gasped.
But Atom didn’t stop...
Its self‐repair protocols engaged! Soon, its circuits started glowing as the damage was sealed almost instantly.
"What in the world... Is that some kind of nanotechnology? How is the fare?" Kai muttered as he realized how terrifying S-Grade Sentinels were!
Furthermore, he somehow felt the power hidden within Atom!

Kai was sure that Atom was just matching his strength to avoid killing him in the process. After all, he was still the owner, and well, he had made the three laws of robotics, which was quite for his sake alone.
Soon, Atom turned with its blade sweeping in a horizontal arc.
Whoosh~
Kai ducked, rolling across the dirt, then sprang up... His Spirit Dominion had already refreshed and it started surging once more.

Chains erupted again, this time striking from multiple angles. They lashed around Atom’s legs, pulling tight. Kai followed with a burst shockwave, the disruption rattling the Sentinel’s systems. Atom stumbled, forced to one knee.
Kai exhaled, sweat dripping down his brow. "Even you can be pushed down."
Atom seemed to have been offended by those words just now as its eyes turned red for a brief moment...
Apparently, its Overdrive Mode was triggered. The Sentinel’s body pulsed with a strong and hot energy before its movements started accelerating!
Crash!
The chains snapped apart as Atom moved!

Kai’s instincts screamed. Slayer’s Flow sharpened his awareness, warning him of the incoming strike. He activated Titan Step, moving sideways just as the blade carved through the air where he had stood. The ground split, a deep scar etched into the dirt.
"Damn... Are you sure you’re not killing me?!" Kai muttered, but his smile widened! It means that he had forced Atom to show a bit more of its strength!
He deserved at least that much recognition!
Atom pressed forward, and Kai felt that he was already reaching his limit...
In the end, Kai had enough hand, and with a wave of his hand, his Gene Weapon appeared!
It was his War Lance!

sentences.text: The heavy gates creaked open as Kai stepped outside the shelter with Atom following close behind.
The Sentinel’s black armor looked so new, and no one had actually realized that it was Atom at first.
"Trust me...
That’s an Evolved Atom!" Kai could only say as the others couldn’t help but look wary.
"Awesome..."
"That looks beautiful."
"I want to have one as well.
Wait...
Are you going to hunt outside, Sir Kai?" One of the guards asked.
"We’re just going to spar.
I don’t think it’s appropriate to use the training grounds." Kai replied.
Hearing that they were about to spar, many residents had gotten curious.
Even the escorts of the Merchant Caravan couldn’t help but look interested.
They wanted to see some entertainment before leaving this shelter.
Just like that, from the ramparts above, several survivors leaned over the edge, curious.
Vera, Steven, and Juno were among them, their eyes were also filled with anticipation.
Others gathered in the watchtower as they waited for the match to start.
It wasn’t every day they saw Kai spar with Atom, especially now that the Sentinel had ascended to a higher level.
Kai stretched his arms, rolling his shoulders, warming up his body.
His muscles felt really nice under the effect of Great Protection, every movement smooth and more controlled.
"Hu~"
He drew in a deep breath, letting Slayer’s Flow circulate Spirit Energy through his body more efficiently than ever before...
"Alright, Atom," Kai muttered, his voice steady.
"Let’s give them a show.
Don’t hold back too much."
Atom didn’t respond, but its eyes or optics glowed brighter.
Soon, the blade extended with a metallic hiss, gleaming like obsidian.
Its stance shifted, precise and deliberate, as if acknowledging Kai’s words.
Kai smirked faintly.
"Good.
Let’s begin."
Kai had three Gene Weapons.
They were Specter Edge, Strength Gauntlet, and War Lance.
He could immediately start with these Gene Weapons, but for now, he decided to rely on his physique.
Bam!
The spar started with a sudden burst.
Kai launched forward, activating Titan Step.
His body moved so quickly, phasing briefly as he dashed across the open ground.
Boom!
The impact of his landing sent a ripple through the dirt, a shockwave of force that made the ramparts tremble.
Atom raised its blade instantly, intercepting Kai’s charge and meeting his palm strike!
"Let’s see!"
Steel clashed against Spirit‐reinforced Flesh.
Bam!
The collision echoed like thunder.
Kai gritted his teeth, pushing forward with brute strength, his arm swelling under the residual effect of Beast Arm woven into Titan Step.
Indeed, despite the fusion, the essence of the Beast Arm was still there!
’So this is what it means by combining high compatibility skills...’
Atom held firm.
Its body was able to absorb the impact from his strike...
Still, the blade scraped against Kai’s hardened skin.
"Not bad," Kai muttered before stepping back.
After adjusting his balance, he then raised his hand.
And used up a chunk of his Spirit Points...
[ Skill Activated: Spirit Dominion ]
Chains made of Spirit Energy burst forth, lashing out toward Atom.
They wrapped around its limbs, with its suppressive force.
At the same time, a shockwave erupted, disrupting the air and scattering dust.
Boom!
Even the ramparts shook as the energy pulse reverberated outward!
Atom staggered for a moment, but its systems quickly realized the strength of his Gene Skill and swiftly adjusted its power!
Still, the chains tightened, immobilizing its arms.
Kai smirked.
"Got you."
But Atom finally gathered its momentum!
Its Adaptive Energy Shield was activated, covering its entire body.
The chains strained, then shattered against the barrier.
Atom stepped forward with its blade slicing through the air!
Thankfully, his movement skill refreshed its cooldown, so he activated Titan Step again.
His body vanished, phasing past the strike, before reappearing behind Atom.
"Haa!"
He swung his fist, reinforced by the titan force behind the movement skill!
Kai wasn’t sure where the best place to hit but in the end, he struck Atom’s back!
Bam!
The blow landed with a resounding crack, forcing Atom forward a step.
The crowd gasped.
But Atom didn’t stop...
Its self‐repair protocols engaged!
Soon, its circuits started glowing as the damage was sealed almost instantly.
"What in the world...
Is that some kind of nanotechnology?
How is the fare?" Kai muttered as he realized how terrifying S-Grade Sentinels were!
Furthermore, he somehow felt the power hidden within Atom!
Kai was sure that Atom was just matching his strength to avoid killing him in the process.
After all, he was still the owner, and well, he had made the three laws of robotics, which was quite for his sake alone.
Soon, Atom turned with its blade sweeping in a horizontal arc.
Whoosh~
Kai ducked, rolling across the dirt, then sprang up...
His Spirit Dominion had already refreshed and it started surging once more.
Chains erupted again, this time striking from multiple angles.
They lashed around Atom’s legs, pulling tight.
Kai followed with a burst shockwave, the disruption rattling the Sentinel’s systems.
Atom stumbled, forced to one knee.
Kai exhaled, sweat dripping down his brow.
"Even you can be pushed down."
Atom seemed to have been offended by those words just now as its eyes turned red for a brief moment...
Apparently, its Overdrive Mode was triggered.
The Sentinel’s body pulsed with a strong and hot energy before its movements started accelerating!
Crash!
The chains snapped apart as Atom moved!
Kai’s instincts screamed.
Slayer’s Flow sharpened his awareness, warning him of the incoming strike.
He activated Titan Step, moving sideways just as the blade carved through the air where he had stood.
The ground split, a deep scar etched into the dirt.
"Damn...
Are you sure you’re not killing me?!" Kai muttered, but his smile widened!
It means that he had forced Atom to show a bit more of its strength!
He deserved at least that much recognition!
Atom pressed forward, and Kai felt that he was already reaching his limit...
In the end, Kai had enough hand, and with a wave of his hand, his Gene Weapon appeared!
It was his War Lance!

chapters.title: Chapter 289: The Duel and the Notification
paragraphs: [ Gene Weapon: War Lance ]
[ Grade: Mid ]
[ Type: Piercing Lance ]
[ Effects: +30% Piercing Damage. Attacks ignore 20% of target’s defense. Effective against armored and shielded targets. ]

[ Secondary Effect: Perfect Thrust - repeated strikes on the same point increase penetration chance. After three consecutive hits on the same spot, the next thrust guarantees armor break. Cooldown: 1 second.
Activation Cost: 15 Spirit Energy per activation ]
[ Durability: 100/100 ]
The War Lance glowed into existence...
Everyone, including the ones on the ramparts watching the battle, saw how the lance appeared as if it were summoned out of nowhere.
The weapon was dark, and it seemed quite fragile because of how glossy it was.
However, since they knew that it was a Gene Weapon, they could only imagine its limitations.
Soon, the crowd around gasped as Kai pointed his weapon at his opponent.
Atom’s optics flared, shifting from calm blue to a sharp crimson glow.
This time, it wasn’t a temporary alarm. It was at this point that the Sentinel’s stance changed instantly. It seemed as if it was no longer hesitating!
Kai smirked. "So you recognize the War Lance, huh? Good. Let’s see how you handle this."
He then charged forward with the Titan Step, propelling himself with a burst of speed.
Whoosh~’
His body endured all this as he phased past Atom’s guard!
Then, his War Lance thrust forward!
[ Gene Weapon Skill Activated: Perfect Thrust ]
The lance struck Atom’s chest, piercing through its Adaptive Shield.
Sparks erupted as the weapon drilled into the same point repeatedly, each thrust faster than the last.
The third strike shattered the shield at that spot while the fourth drove deep into the alloy frame!
"Break!" Kai shouted...
Atom staggered back, but its armor held!
Nonetheless, seeing how Atom was struggling, the crowd erupted in cheers, stunned that Kai had managed to pierce the Sentinel’s defenses.
But Atom wasn’t finished.
Its self‐repair protocols engaged... It felt as if it were some kind of nanotech circuits glowing as the damage sealed.
"Wow! Good job, Atom! Let’s see its limit then!" Kai shouted. He was truly impressed by Atom’s regeneration!
Nonetheless, the fight wasn’t over yet.
The Sentinel’s blade extended fully as well.
Whoosh~
It swung in a vertical slash, forcing Kai to retreat.
Kai then activated his Spirit Dominion!
"Stay!"
Soon, chains burst forth to intercept the strike.
They lashed around Atom’s blade arm, pulling it tight!
At the same time, a shockwave erupted to disrupt its balance.
Atom faltered for a moment as its systems were rattled once more.
"Come on!"
Kai pressed forward with his Titan Step, propelling him into a flanking position.
He thrust the War Lance again, aiming for the same weak point...
Bam!
The weapon drilled forward, piercing deeper...
Once again, Atom triggered the Overdrive Mode!
Soon, a mysterious energy was pulsing violently inside Atom!
The chains snapped apart just like what happened before, and soon, the Sentinel’s movements accelerated beyond normal limits.
Kai’s instincts screamed.
Slayer’s Flow sharpened his awareness, warning him of the incoming counter from Atom.
He then moved to his left, narrowly avoiding the blade that carved a deep scar into the ground.
"Damn... you’re really going all out now," Kai muttered, sweat dripping down his brow...
"But that’s what I wanted..."
Atom advanced relentlessly, with its blade trying to reach him repeatedly.
However, Kai blocked with the War Lance!
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Sparks flying as steel clashed against spirit‐reinforced alloy. Each impact rattled his arms, forcing him back step by step.
However, Kai was able to endure it!
"Alright... I still have half my Spirit Points... One more try, I guess." Kai muttered.
Just like that, he activated Spirit Dominion once more.
Chains erupted from the ground, lashing around Atom’s legs...
It was the same tactic but this time, he thrust the War Lance in perfect sequence, drilling into the same point again...
Thud!
The crowd gasped...
Just like before, Atom’s systems surged, repairing the damage instantly.
However, during the repair, Kai had noticed how Atom had actually slowed down a lot!
It was a perfect opportunity for him!
The Sentinel’s crimson optics dimmed slightly, as if recalibrating...
’Got you...’
Kai used his Titan Step and arrived behind Atom!
However, instead of striking the Sentinel, he lowered his weapon and breathed heavily. His Spirit reserves were down by 60%!
Since the A.I. Apocalypse was still here, Kai didn’t dare to exhaust his Spirit Energy.
He has to be prepared to fight in case the A.I. Army suddenly attacks.
"Alright... that’s enough. I’ve seen what I needed."
Atom froze, and soon, its blade retracted slowly.
Kai exhaled, slowing his breath. He glanced up at the ramparts, where the crowd murmured in awe.
"No winner today. Just progress!" Kai shouted.
Kai didn’t linger after the spar.
Once Atom’s blade retracted and the crowd dispersed, he knew his next priority... ensuring every shelter under his care had enough Survivor Medals to compete in the upcoming Auction.
He traveled first to Freedom Shelter, where survivors greeted him with relief.
Kai organized exchanges, helping them convert excess resources into medals through the Gene Trader’s system.
He reminded them to be careful...
Next was Haven‐28, where morale was lower. It seemed that they had been attacked by some Sentinels while he was away. Thankfully, X-06 and other modified Sentinels were here.
Kai personally oversaw the conversion of scavenged equipment into medals, even giving some more of his own reserves to boost their numbers.
Finally, he returned to New Haven‐45, his strongest base. The survivors there had already stockpiled medals thanks to his earlier strategies, but Kai reinforced their confidence.
"We’ll enter the Auction prepared. No one here will be left behind."
By the time he finished his rounds, the Global System Notification appeared.
[ Global Event Reminder ]
[ Special Operation: Black Market Auction ]
[ Time Remaining: 3 Hours ]
[ Duration: 2 Days ]
[ Instruction: Survivors who have obtained Auction Tokens will soon be transported. ]
[ Note: All qualified Survivors will disappear from this world and enter a separate realm prepared by the Gene Traders. Only those with tokens may enter. ]

chapters.title: Chapter 290: The Global Event and Attracting Attention
paragraphs: While everyone was doing their best to accumulate more Survivor Medals, the Global Notification appeared.
All Foreign Survivors within the continent received a similar message!
"Ahh! Just three hours left. I only gathered 12 Survivor Medals."
"Shit... Why are C-Grade Energy Cores only worth 0.10 Points each anyway?!"
"Three hours... I still need at least 20 more. What am I supposed to offer the Gene Trader now?"
At this point, even the World Chat started getting noisy.

[ Joseph: Hey, don’t panic. Remember, rare resources convert better. If you have a whole A.I. Unit like Spyder, Tyrant, and even their Gunships, you’ll earn better. With Unique items, the rate jumps significantly. ]
[ Eliza: Easy for you to say! I only have scraps from the mines. The Gene Trader barely gave me anything for them. ]
[ Claire: You should’ve joined our Codebreakers Guild. Almost all members of the Codebreakers already have their tokens secured. ]
[ Lesley: Our Supreme Guild is catching up. Your Codebreakers Guild might be the first but our Guild has the highest number of members! We’re going to surpass you soon. ]
[ Mei: Having a small number of Elites is better than a large number of nobodies. ]
[ Lesley: Huh? Are you saying we’re nobodies? ]
[ Mei: Just kidding. ]

[ Owen: Hey, look at this notification again... What will happen to our shelter if we disappear? We’re not going to get attacked by the A.I. Army, right? What if we return with a shelter under fire? ]
[ Thomas: Just pray. Don’t think too much of it. ]
[ Hannah: Two days inside the Auction realm... Can you imagine what kind of items will appear? Forbidden technologies, genetic resources... If we miss this, we’ll never catch up. ]

[ Eliza: Stop whining... Don’t attend the event if you’re too worried about your shelter. Ayway, three hours is still time to scrape something together. Even one more medal could make the difference. ]
[ Connie: Yeah, but the conversion rates are brutal. The Gene Trader rejected half my stuff outright. Not even 0.01 points! Just pure rejection! ]
[ Farrah: Then gamble it. Offer everything. Try to offer your organ or something. Better to risk it now than regret it later. ]
[ Connie: WTF? ]
In the meantime, Kai closed the world chat and remained in his pod within the New Haven-45, staring at the message.
[ Global Event Reminder ]
[ Special Operation: Black Market Auction ]
[ Time Remaining: 3 Hours ]
[ Duration: 2 Days ]
[ Instruction: Survivors who have obtained Auction Tokens will soon be transported. ]
[ Note: All qualified Survivors will disappear from this world and enter a separate realm prepared by the Gene Traders. Only those with tokens may enter. ]
[ Warning: Survivors without Auction Tokens will remain behind. Entry is strictly forbidden without a token. ]
[ Currency: Survivor Medals remain the primary bidding currency. ]
[ Reminder: Auction halls are neutral zones under Gene Trader protection. Combat is restricted inside. ]

During these remaining hours, Kai decided to summon more Gift Packs... They were not to be converted into points, but instead, they would be for the rest of the people who would be staying in this shelter.
After all, despite having enough Modified Sentinels on their side, the Diggers could still cause some problems.
He could only hope that their preparation was more than enough to deal with the new types in case they attacked while they were away...
Time quickly passed, and soon, the timer reached zero.
[ Global Event Transfer ]
[ Special Operation: Black Market Auction ]
[ Status: Commencing ]
[ Instruction: Survivors with Auction Tokens will now be transported. ]
One by one, survivors clutching their tokens began to dissipate.
Their bodies shimmered with a faint glow before vanishing entirely, leaving behind stunned companions.
The shelters echoed with gasps and murmurs as dozens of foreign survivors disappeared into thin air.
Kai also felt the pull immediately. His Auction Token glowed brightly, and before he could take another breath, his vision blurred.
The world around him dissolved, replaced by a vast, unfamiliar horizon.
"T-that doesn’t feel comfortable." Kai muttered.
He arrived in a mysterious land that seemed endless. The ground beneath him was smooth and metallic, stretching far into the distance.

Towering structures could be seen in the background, but their designs weren’t towering structures but more like circular structures... It was like a fusion of futuristic technology and ancient architecture.

Kai blinked, adjusting to the new environment. He was standing on a massive platform crowded with survivors. Thousands of figures filled the space, each one clutching their weapons, tokens, or packs of resources.
A notification appeared before his eyes.
[ Congratulations, Survivor! ]
[ You have successfully entered the Auction Realm. ]
[ Current Location: Platform 5 ]
[ Note: Survivors have been distributed across Platforms 1 to 20 to prevent overcrowding. Each platform contains thousands of participants. ]
Kai scanned the crowd. The sheer number of survivors was staggering. He realized that this was only one of twenty platforms. The scale of the event was far beyond anything he had imagined.
Another notification followed.
[ Auction Realm Overview ]
[ Description: This realm is structured as a vast metropolitan city, designed by the Gene Traders. ]
[ Facilities: Each platform contains trading districts, resource exchanges, and private stalls where survivors may barter with sellers. ]
[ Main Event: The Black Market Auction will be held in the Grand Arena. Tens of thousands of survivors will gather for the bidding war. ]
[ Duration:
Day 1 - Global Auction Event. All survivors may participate.
Day 2 - Exclusive Auction Event. Only survivors with 300 or more Survivor Medals remaining after Day 1 will qualify. ]
[ Reminder: Auction halls are neutral zones under Gene Trader protection. Combat is strictly forbidden inside. ]
Kai relaxed as he stared at the endless cityscape.
The platforms were connected by glowing bridges that stretched into the distance, leading toward the heart of the metropolis where the Grand Arena was located.
He could already see stalls opening, merchants shouting, and survivors looking around for rare items before the main event.

"This is interesting. So there are tens of thousands still alive on the continent... I wonder why they’re not active in the world chat." Kai mused as he confirmed that the World Chat was indeed limited. Perhaps, there’s another Global Chat.
Nonetheless, Kai had to focus on his current situation. Soon, he noticed something really important!
"They’re mostly wearing the Survivor Gear given by the System..." Kai muttered as he realized that his outfit was gathering quite some attention!

[ Auction Realm Overview ]
[ Description: This realm is structured as a vast metropolitan city, designed by the Gene Traders. ]
[ Facilities: Each platform contains trading districts, resource exchanges, and private stalls where survivors may barter with sellers. ]
[ Main Event: The Black Market Auction will be held in the Grand Arena.
Tens of thousands of survivors will gather for the bidding war. ]
[ Duration:
Day 1 - Global Auction Event.
All survivors may participate.
Day 2 - Exclusive Auction Event.
Only survivors with 300 or more Survivor Medals remaining after Day 1 will qualify. ]
[ Reminder: Auction halls are neutral zones under Gene Trader protection.
Combat is strictly forbidden inside. ]
Kai relaxed as he stared at the endless cityscape.
The platforms were connected by glowing bridges that stretched into the distance, leading toward the heart of the metropolis where the Grand Arena was located.
He could already see stalls opening, merchants shouting, and survivors looking around for rare items before the main event.
"This is interesting.
So there are tens of thousands still alive on the continent...
I wonder why they’re not active in the world chat." Kai mused as he confirmed that the World Chat was indeed limited.
Perhaps, there’s another Global Chat.
Nonetheless, Kai had to focus on his current situation.
Soon, he noticed something really important!
"They’re mostly wearing the Survivor Gear given by the System..." Kai muttered as he realized that his outfit was gathering quite some attention!

chapters.title: Chapter 291: The Auction Realm
paragraphs: Kai’s eyes swept across the endless platform, taking in the diversity of survivors gathered here. The outfits alone told him stories of their backgrounds, their struggles, and the paths they had taken within the Versailles Continent.
Most wore the standard Survivor Gear provided by the System... They were sturdy vests, reinforced cargo pants, and boots designed for utility rather than style.
It was the uniform of practicality...
Still, others looked far rougher. Some wore dirty mechanic’s clothes, grease‐stained jackets, and patched trousers.
They even carried tool belts instead of weapons, their survival was clearly tied to machines and scavenged technology...
Then there were those in combat gear. They wore leather armor strengthened with shoulder guards, bracers, and layered padding.
Their outfits were mismatched, probably scavenged from different battles, but functional. These survivors looked like mercenaries in Kai’s eyes.

Then, he noticed another group clad in urban scavenger attire... hooded jackets, torn jeans, and makeshift masks covering their faces. Their gear was pieced together from scraps, even badly welded armor plates in place.
And then, a smaller but striking group of people wore ceremonial combat uniforms like a robe... They looked almost like warrior‐priests.
’Interesting bunch...’

Kai’s gaze lingered on these varied outfits. However, he soon realized how much attention he was drawing to himself. Unlike the patched leather, grease‐stained cloth, or System‐issued gear, his attire was unmistakably advanced.
What he wore now came from the Superior Grade Stealth Gift Pack... the advanced camouflage gear.
None of them had probably even heard anything about the Superior Grade Gift Pack.
Even though the stealth mode wasn’t activated, the suit itself was striking.
A black full‐body suit covered him from head to toe, sleek and seamless.
The slim helmet concealed his features, its visor tinted dark, while the fitted black shoes completed the ensemble.
Indeed, no face or skin could be seen with his gear on.
It wouldn’t be surprising that he’d attract attention at all.
The suit hugged his frame perfectly as every line seemed engineered for efficiency. It wasn’t bulky like armor, nor ragged like scavenger gear... It was clean and quite intimidating...
Even inactive, the suit radiated an aura of professionalism, the kind of gear only elites could possess.
Anyway, Kai could feel eyes on him. Some of them were even pointing discreetly at him. His outfit marked him as someone different...
"I wonder where he got that suit..." one survivor muttered.
"Maybe I should ask if he bought it somewhere. It doesn’t look like anything the Gene Traders ever offered."
Another voice chimed in. He was quite skeptical about the design. "I think it’s handmade, maybe? Some kind of custom work? If someone in his world can make gear like that, I’d pay anything for it."
A group nearby debated quietly as well...
"What if his shelter has a craftsman? Imagine if they’re selling suits like that. Ohhh... We should look around here... maybe there’s a stall offering something similar."
"No, forget that," another replied. "This is the Auction Realm. We might even find something better than what he’s wearing. But still... damn, he looks cool."
Kai caught a laugh from behind him.
"Cool? He looks like a shadow. I bet he’s using that to sneak at night... I feel like that guy could vanish right in front of us."
Someone else whispered with a grin, "I wonder if he has a wife. Whoever she is, she’s lucky. He looks like one of those elite operatives or something back on Earth."
The murmurs grew, blending admiration with suspicion.
As Kai thought walked around to look at the stalls, he continued getting the same comments.
Still, after a few moments, they realized that he wasn’t the only one wearing the same outfit.
As a matter of fact, all members of the Codebreakers Guild are wearing the same thing!
This wouldn’t just help them identify themselves, but also help them get their Guild famous.
At this time, no one was aware of their Guild, but soon, if one of them were asked or if they announced it, it would surely spread immediately. Kai did not doubt that at all.
The Codebreakers Guild had an incredible full black outfit...
"They must be in the same shelter."
"That wouldn’t be surprising. Or perhaps, they found the same seller."

Kai smirked faintly beneath the visor. He didn’t need to respond... the suit spoke for itself. The Superior Grade Stealth Gift Pack wasn’t something these survivors could even imagine owning. To them, it was a mystery, a symbol of power and exclusivity that they couldn’t obtain just yet.
The whispers continued...
"If he’s got gear like that, what else is he hiding? Weapons? Tech? Maybe he’s already rich in Survivor Medals."
"Or maybe he’s bluffing. A suit doesn’t mean strength. Let’s see how he does in the Auction."
Kai could only shake his head as he continued walking.
He could feel the weight of their stares, the curiosity, and the envy. It didn’t bother him... in fact, it was useful. Attention meant influence, and influence might help his Guild some day.
Just like that, the crowd’s voices faded into the background as Kai focused on the city stretching before him.
"Guess I look cooler than I thought."
Kai moved deeper into the platform and saw countless stalls.
The Auction Realm had rows of vendors shouting prices, survivors trying to haggle and weapons displayed like trophies.
The first stores he passed specialized in cold weapons. Blades of every shape lined the racks... machetes, longswords, spears, and crude axes forged from scavenged steel.
Some were polished, others looked like they had been hammered together in desperation.
’Well... You’ll get what you pay for, I guess.’Kai mused.
Survivors tested their edges, swinging them experimentally, but Kai barely slowed.
He already had access to a reliable axe and didn’t need another crude blade.
Next came the firearm stalls.
He found rifles, shotguns, and pistols were stacked neatly...
Ammunition crates sat beside them, marked with conversion rates for Survivor Medals.
Kai studied them briefly, but nothing caught his attention.
He already had a carbine rifle, grenade launchers, smoke grenades, stun grenades, and even an emergency thruster pack. Compared to his arsenal, these weapons felt ordinary.
Still, there were a few things that stirred his curiosity.
"These things look amazing..."
One stall displayed flamethrowers with their tanks were heavy and intimidating.
Another showcased chainsaws, modified with stronger teeth and spirit‐conductive engines. Explosives were also on sale... bundles of dynamite, crude mines, and improvised charges.
"Now... The Diggers will feel this, right?"
Kai’s eyes lingered on these. They weren’t necessities, but they were tools of chaos, weapons that could change the tide of battle in unexpected ways.
He didn’t rush. The Auction hadn’t begun yet, and Kai knew better than to get pressured into early purchases.

There were too many stalls, too many sellers. Somewhere in this vast city, better deals were waiting. He walked calmly, ignoring the merchants who tried to lure him with promises of "rare stock" and "limited offers."
It wasn’t long before he found something more familiar... a Gene Store. Its entrance was marked by glowing sigils, and inside, shelves were lined with vials and capsules.
Kai stepped in, his visor scanning the inventory.

He immediately recognized the Gene Stimulants... small injections that temporarily boosted strength and reflexes. Beside them were Gene Enhancement Serums, designed to permanently improve their physique and even compatibility with genetic weapons.
He spotted Blood Boosting Serums, meant to accelerate recovery, and Heart Revival Serums, emergency injections capable of restarting a failing body.
Other items filled the shelves... Spirit Amplifiers, which increased energy output for a short time.
Neural Accelerants, capable of sharpening reaction speed, and Bone Hardeners, designed to reinforce skeletal durability.
It was a treasure trove of genetic modifications, each vial glowing faintly with promise.
However, he found all of them to be so expensive...
"Holy... 20 Survivor Medals of one Spirit Amplifier? What a scam..." Kai muttered.
Of course, he already noticed these absurd prices from the cold weapons being sold, but he thought that it was only because of their rarity.
But now, he has just realized that this whole city itself was too expensive!
"W-what?"
Just now, Kai realized that even a 1 liter of bottled coconut water was being traded for 1 Survivor Medal.
"Incredibly absurd." Kai muttered as he shook his head.
In any case, Kai soon moved deeper into the gene store, but before he could examine further, several more customers entered. They weren’t here for the serums... they were here for him.
"Hey," one of them said, eyes fixed on Kai’s suit. "Where did you buy that?"
Another stepped closer, circling him. "That outfit... it’s not from the Gene Traders. Tell us where you got it."
Kai ignored them, continuing to scan the shelves. But the men didn’t leave. They surrounded him, their hands gripping his shoulders.
"Remove it," one demanded. "We want to test if it fits us."

Kai frowned beneath his visor. His fists clenched instinctively. He wanted to punch them, to break their arrogance, but he recalled fighting was prohibited here. Any violence inside the Auction Realm meant disqualification. He couldn’t risk it.
Still, there was no way he would let them continue.
